parent_programme.relationship: Phase-VII observation-process stress test; Phase-VI perfect-assay results remain immutable

scientific_question: When Phase-VI parameter assays are themselves subject to an unknown systematic observation process, which future-target evidence certificates remain robust, when is assay-process calibration required, and can repeated use of the same biased assay substitute for calibration?

fixed_ecological_universe.analysis_units: unique same-G W1 fibers with more than one binary future-target class; truth-weighted summaries may be derived afterward

assay_observation_worlds.ordinal_mapping: observed=true integer code + 1; off-scale integer outputs are retained rather than clipped

action_library.parameter_assay: one observation of a declared parameter field under the unknown global assay-observation world
action_library.repeat_same_assay_twice: two repeated observations of the same field under the same global systematic assay world; represented as the ordered pair of the deterministic coded outcome
action_library.assay_process_calibration: idealized direct calibration that deterministically reports calibrated versus systematically_miscalibrated

joint_hypotheses: same-G ecological W1 variant x assay-observation world
target: transformation-specific binary future decision projected from ecological variant; assay world is nuisance uncertainty
robust_separation: two target-discordant joint hypotheses are robustly separated by an action iff their possible outcome sets are disjoint
minimum_design: exact smallest action subset that robustly separates every pair of active joint hypotheses with different binary future-target values; same-target pairs need not be separated

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every parameter field and every scored fiber, repeating the same deterministic systematically biased assay twice robustly separates exactly the same target-discordant joint-hypothesis pairs as one assay.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any pair-cover difference is an implementation/theory failure and stops interpretation.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one future-target-unresolved fiber has no robust parameter-assay-only design under the two admitted assay worlds but has a finite robust design when assay-process calibration is added.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every unresolved target is robustly solvable without calibration or remains unsolvable even with calibration.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For the frozen S11 dormant-climate fiber, the exact minimum robust target design is {assay_process_calibration, assay:A_level}, size 2; repeated A_level assays without calibration are insufficient.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any different exact minimum, size, or repeat-only sufficiency refutes H3.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every scored future-target-unresolved W1 fiber is robustly separable by the frozen action library when assay-process calibration is available.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any fiber remaining target-unresolved under the complete calibrated action library refutes H4.

secondary_outputs: exact robust minimum action-size distribution by transformation
fraction of unresolved fibers requiring calibration
fields appearing in lexicographically canonical robust minimum designs
comparison to Phase-VI perfect-assay target burden as descriptive only
claim_boundary: Systematic coding bias is a synthetic observation-process fixture, not a calibrated laboratory error model.
The calibration action is an idealized upper-bound channel.
Robust separation is support-based guarantee logic, not expected information gain or probabilistic optimal design.
Repeated-assay equivalence applies to a fixed systematic observation world and must not be generalized to independent random measurement error.
Do not claim generic novelty for measurement-error correction, calibration, robust experimental design or partial identification under misclassification.
Do not alter Phase-I through Phase-VI or the frozen EOG-WF and first BAM manuscripts.
candidate_contribution: BAM-specific target-aware evidence routing over occurrence-conditioned future-target survivor fibers when ecological-world uncertainty is crossed explicitly with an assay-observation-process universe.
